LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Hint: These switches and thresholds apply to every nanny robot immediately. Pause, recall, goto, rename and paint are available on each selected robot.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Sweep.Desc: Clean filth inside the home area.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Scrub.Desc: Clean filth outside the home area, such as after a raid.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Haul.Desc: Carry loose items into vertical warehouses or stockpiles. Corpses are skipped.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Firefight.De: Beat out fires inside the work area.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Butcher.Desc: Use butcher-table bills to process corpses.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.CorpseDispos: Let Mk-V carry enemy corpses to a burn pit or crematorium, or into a stockpile that accepts corpses.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Refuel.Desc: Refuel wood-fired and chemfuel generators below the threshold.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.FeedPrisoner: Feed or deliver meals to hungry colony prisoners, and bring food to bedridden patients.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Water.Desc: Bring 1 L bottled water to thirsty patients and prisoners who cannot reach water; feed those who cannot hold a bottle, and fall back to filling a basin or bucket.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Plants.Desc: Harvest mature crops in growing zones, cut designated trees and plants, and sow empty fields.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Hygiene.Desc: Empty septic tanks and unblock fixtures. Bathroom floor filth is still handled even when sweeping is off.
Rope colony animals back to pens or hitching posts, and unrope them when needed.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Storage.Desc: Prefer delivering hauled items directly into vertical warehouses.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Rescue.Desc: Carry downed colony members to a bed first.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Cook.Desc: Let Mk-V work cooking bills at stoves.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Doctor.Desc: Let Mk-V tend injured colonists and prisoners.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Research.Des: Let Mk-V work research benches on the current project.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Crafting.Des: Let Mk-V work bills at crafting spots, fabrication, smithy, tailoring and art benches.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.DangerAvoida: Stop chores and return to the station while enemies are near or the map is at high danger.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.CarryCapacit: The final value shown on the info card, 60-600. Vanilla scales carrying capacity by body size; this mod uses the setting directly. Higher values let a robot haul or pick up more per trip. Caravan mass capacity is a separate value and is not affected.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.StartWithMkV: Spawn this many Mk-V androids (0-5, default 1) on the player's starting map in a new game. 0 disables the gift. Existing saves are not affected.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVCombatEna: Let Mk-V acquire targets, fire and return automatically. When off, Mk-V only performs chores.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVReturnToB: Return to the Mk-V assembly bay when the target leaves engage range. When off, Mk-V resumes chores in place.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVAutoPicku: Mk-V looks for a higher-scoring ranged weapon and swaps to it. When off, it keeps its issued arc emitter.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVDualWield: Mk-V carries one weapon in each hand: a ranged weapon plus a melee weapon (shoot at range, cut up close) or two ranged weapons (both fire together). When both hands are full, equipping another weapon drops the non-exclusive one; the exclusive arc emitter is never replaced.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkvArcBladeH: Damage, attack interval and armor penetration of the arc blade are all configurable (defaults 50 / 1.3 s / 40%; the weapon info card follows). On hit there is also a chance to paralyse the target (default 50%, 10 hours) and to chain that paralysis to other enemies nearby (default 20%, 5 cells). Set a chance to 0% to disable that effect; paralysis and chain only affect hostile targets.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVInsulatio: Built-in insulation works like worn apparel: the cold value lowers the comfortable temperature floor and the heat value raises the ceiling. Defaults 20°C / 30°C.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkvRandomTra: Mk-V always gets Tough, Nimble and Jogger. Turn this on to roll 2 traits out of Brawler, Trigger-happy, Fast learner and Great memory (never all of them); existing traits are never duplicated.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.RobotPowerEf: Shared by all Mk robots; 100% is the baseline, higher values make each battery last longer.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVBayAutoSt: When materials, power and research are all available, the Mk-V bay starts the next robot automatically. When off, start it manually.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVSolarChar: Mk-V passively recharges outdoors when light is above the threshold.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVWindCharg: Mk-V passively recharges outdoors when wind is above the threshold.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.AreaLabel.De: Name of an area on the map. If it is missing, work is unrestricted.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVTextureHi: Body texture, draw size and width/height scale for Mk-V. Changes apply immediately to all Mk-V pawns; the path must provide _north/_south/_east/_west textures.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVTexturePa: Path under Textures without extension, for example Things/Pawn/MkV/MkV.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.DurabilityHi: Durability caps at 1000 for normal robots and 1800 for the Mk-V. It only drops when the robot takes damage (about 250 damage scraps it); daily work does not wear it down. At 0 it scraps into steel and components. Colonists repair it with the Construction work type. Charging is blocked while the robot is being repaired and resumes after repair finishes.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Sounds.Desc: Occasional beeps while working; one low-battery warning.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.ChargingGlow: Light the station while a robot is docked and charging.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Inspect.Repairing: Being repaired: charging waits until repair finishes.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.DisabledInSettings: Disabled in the robot settings page.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Scrapped: {0} was scrapped into steel and components.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Command.Pause.Desc: Pause automatic work. Danger avoidance still applies.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Command.Recall.Desc: Return to the nearest station and wait there.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Command.Goto.Desc: Pick a cell for the robot to walk to.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Command.PrioritizeFilth.Desc: Pick a filth thing for the robot to clean immediately.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Station.Locate.Desc: Jump the camera to the bound robot's current position.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Station.Recall.Desc: Order the bound robot back to this station.
LanguageData.CK.RobotManagement.Title: Robots
LanguageData.CK.RobotManagement.Hint: All nanny robots on this map. Select jumps to a robot; Station jumps to its charging station.
LanguageData.CK.RobotManagement.None: No nanny robots on this map.
LanguageData.CK.RobotManagement.WorkHint: Priorities 1–8 (1 is highest): left-click lowers, right-click raises; 0 disables the chore. The settings tab master switch still has to be on.

LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Chore.Water.Desc: Bring bottled water to thirsty patients and prisoners who cannot reach water, and feed those who cannot drink on their own.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Chore.Plants.Label: Plants
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Chore.Plants.Desc: Harvest ripe crops, cut designated trees and plants, and sow empty fields.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Ai.Enabled.D: Let Mk-V periodically send the current situation and candidate actions to DeepSeek and follow the chosen one. With the master switch off, every Mk-V uses the regular AI.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Ai.Hint: Requires a DeepSeek API key (OpenAI-compatible endpoint). The key is stored in plain text in the mod settings; use a dedicated low-quota key. Only in-game state and candidate actions are sent, never save files.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Ai.ApiKey.De: A sk-... key from the DeepSeek console; it stays in the local mod settings only.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Ai.BaseUrl.D: Defaults to https://api.deepseek.com; a full /chat/completions URL also works.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Ai.Model.Des: Defaults to deepseek-flash; deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner (slower, pricier) also work.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Ai.Combat.De: When off, no attack targets are offered; the AI only rescues, firefights, returns, patrols or works.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Ai.Speech.De: Show the returned short line as floating text above the Mk-V.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Ai.Cost: Every request consumes DeepSeek quota; the defaults are one request per 20 s and at most 2 concurrent requests. The API key is stored in the local Config folder; keep it safe.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Command.Ai.Desc: Toggle whether this Mk-V follows DeepSeek decisions. Nothing is sent while the settings master switch is off.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Ai.NoKey: Mk-V AI is enabled but no DeepSeek API key is set. Open Settings → Robots → Mk-V AI to add one.
